***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[2026 Strait of Hormuz campaign]]
*****The [[International Maritime Organization]] announces an evacuation plan for around 500 to 600 ships with 11,000 seafarers stranded in the [[Persian Gulf]] to sail through the [[Strait of Hormuz]] after [[Iran]] and the [[United States]] have reached a [[2026 Iran war ceasefire|ceasefire]] [[Islamabad Memorandum|deal]] to end the [[war]]. The evacuation will be coordinated with Iran and [[Oman]]. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/un-shipping-agency-announces-evacuation-11000-seafarers-stranded-gulf (''Middle East Eye'')] [https://maritime-executive.com/article/imo-and-oman-launch-phased-evacuation-for-transits-in-strait-of-hormuz (The Maritime Executive)] 
****The [[Bangladesh Shipping Corporation]] reports that the [[Bangladesh]]-flagged [[Deadweight tonnage|DWT]] [[bulk carrier]] vessel MV ''Banglar Joyjatra'' has cleared through the Strait of Hormuz at 3:00am [[Bangladesh Standard Time|BST]] after it was stranded in the region for 4.5 months. [https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/banglar-joyjatra-clears-strait-hormuz-after-four-and-half-month-ordeal-1469926 (''The Business Standard'')] [https://www.newagebd.net/post/foreign-affairs/303704/bangladeshi-ship-banglar-joyjatra-crosses-strait-of-hormuz (''New Age BD'')]
****[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] says that the U.S. will not accept Iranian tolls or fees on vessels transiting through the Strait of Hormuz. [https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/921719/us-secretary-of-state-rejects-iranian-tolls-on-strait-of-hormuz (Kurdistan24)] 
***[[2026 United States F-15E rescue operation in Iran]]
****Two sources tell [[CNN]] that a pilot on a [[United States Armed Forces]] [[McDonnell Douglas F-15E Strike Eagle|F-15E Strike Eagle]], which was downed over [[Iran]] during the beginning of April, reported a "[[jellyfish]]-like" formation from [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|Iranian drones]] before the jet was shot down. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/us-israel-iran-war/downed-us-f-15-pilot-describes-multiple-iranian-drones-in-jellyfish-formation-report/3975773 (AA)] [https://www.cnn.com/2026/06/23/politics/iran-drones-f-15-pilot-intelligence (CNN)]

****The [[Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory]], a [[United Nations fact-finding mission]], finds that [[Israel]] has deliberately targeted [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] children, resulting in [[Gaza genocide|genocide]], crimes against humanity, [[War crimes in the Gaza war|war crimes in Gaza]], and war crimes in the [[West Bank]]. **[[Nigeria]]n [[Nigeria Police Force|police]] report that at least 20 people were killed in an attack on a community in [[Bokkos]], [[Plateau State]], over the weekend. Police and other [[Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps|security agencies]] engaged the assailants in a [[shootout]] before they withdrew from the area. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Housing in the United States]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] passes the [[21st Century ROAD to Housing Act]] in an effort to lower the [[Cost of living|cost-of-living]] of houses and support [[affordable housing]] in [[United States|the country]]. The legislation will head to [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] for his signature. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/house-affordable-housing-bill-trump.html (CNBC)]

**The [[Government of National Stability]], which controls eastern [[Libya]], prohibits the entry of citizens of [[Eritrea]], [[Ethiopia]], [[Somalia]], and [[Sudan]] through all land, sea and air ports, citing a reorganization of procedures governing the entry of foreign nationals.
